failure: Stop only the disposable CloudLaunch-owned container
evidence: Docker exited identity + failed HTTP probe
diagnosis: Collect native state and exit reason; cause remains a hypothesis
remediation: Separate exact-plan approval then allowlisted Docker restart
verification: Matching container, HTTP 200, fresh Prometheus scrape and Alertmanager resolution
cleanup: CloudLaunch cleanup validates the recorded ownership label

failure: Use a wrong endpoint in a disposable configuration
evidence: HTTP failure while container may remain running
remediation: Correct scoped configuration after review; restart alone may fail
verification: Configured HTTP policy; wrong endpoint must remain failed

evidence: CrashLoopBackOff, previous log signature and restart count
diagnosis: Triage Kubernetes collector and Platform namespace events
remediation: Review startup/configuration; no unapproved cluster changes
verification: Pod readiness, observed rollout generation, endpoint and configured metrics

diagnosis: Check immutable image availability and registry authorization
remediation: Owner-approved corrected image through existing GitOps workflow

evidence: CreateContainerConfigError and referenced missing key, never Secret values

failure: Existing failed deployment in owned Kind lab
verification: Ready replicas, rollout and HTTP policy

failure: Bounded resource fixture only; never exhaust the shared host
diagnosis: Resource limit versus observed pressure, no assumed leak
verification: Sustained readiness and configured resource metrics
